newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: TENNIS-SCHALLER AND SANTORO FORCED OUT BY INJURY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SCHALLER AND SANTORO FORCED OUT BY INJURY.

text.p: Spaniards Javier Sanchez and Alex Corretja moved easily through to the semifinals of the Estoril Open on Friday when their opponents withdrew injured in the second set.

Eighth seed Sanchez beat Austria's Gilbert Schaller, a surprise first round victor over Russia's Yevgeny Kafelnikov, 6-0 4-1 when the Austrian quit their quarter-final with a pulled muscle in his leg.
Corretja, seeded six, had a similarly easy passage against Fabrice Santoro, with the Frenchman withdrawing with a back injury when he was 4-0 down in the second set after having lost the first 6-3.
With four Spaniards disputing the other two quarter-finals later on Friday, Spain is guaranteed all four semifinalists.

Australian Open runner-up Carlos Moya, seeded two, was playing Francisco Clavet, seeded seven, while number five seed Alberto Berasategui and Felix Mantilla, seeded four, were due to meet in the last of the quarter-finals.
